messages.content:
={{ $json.language === 'FR' ?
              `Résumé pour ${$json.owner}/${$json.repo} (${new Date($json.weekStart).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')} - ${new Date($json.weekEnd).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')})

` +
              `Commits: ${$json.commits.count}
` +
              `Issues fermées: ${$json.issues.count}
` +
              `PRs fusionnées: ${$json.pullRequests.count}

` +
              `Détails des commits:
${$json.commits.items.map(c => `- ${c.message} (${c.author})`).join('
')}

` +
              `Issues fermées:
${$json.issues.items.map(i => `- #${i.number}: ${i.title}`).join('
')}

` +
              `PRs fusionnées:
${$json.pullRequests.items.map(p => `- #${p.number}: ${p.title} par ${p.author}`).join('
')}` :
              `Summary for ${$json.owner}/${$json.repo} (${new Date($json.weekStart).toLocaleDateString('en-US')} - ${new Date($json.weekEnd).toLocaleDateString('en-US')})

` +
              `Commits: ${$json.commits.count}
` +
              `Closed Issues: ${$json.issues.count}
` +
              `Merged PRs: ${$json.pullRequests.count}

` +
              `Commit details:
${$json.commits.items.map(c => `- ${c.message} (${c.author})`).join('
')}

` +
              `Closed issues:
${$json.issues.items.map(i => `- #${i.number}: ${i.title}`).join('
')}

` +
              `Merged PRs:
${$json.pullRequests.items.map(p => `- #${p.number}: ${p.title} by ${p.author}`).join('
')}` }}
